persons.name: ulkser
persons.digest:
Serkan attributes falling yields despite the hot September CPI to bonds now being a clear alternative. He says yields were being hammered again in the overnight session and that the money flowing into bonds has to come from somewhere. In his view, selling stocks at the top and moving into bonds at the bottom of a five-year bear market is not illogical; seeing around **5.5%** on 5- and 10-year paper makes room for them in a portfolio for balance. He himself buys 2-5 year government bonds through **IBKR**, points to the **IEI** and **SHY** ETFs for others, and **TLT** is in the list too.

On the trading side he writes that his **MRVL** puts and index scalps no longer cover today's **QXO** and **RKT** losses and that he has reached the point where he said daily moves only go so far. He calls **O** the 'silver lining' in this market.

persons.name: Ahmet Sunelcan
persons.digest:
Ahmet's core view has been the same for months: macro is not good, the one good side is AI and it has lost its appetite, with fear taking its place; so he expected more than small corrections. He treats the deterioration of **KOSPI** and **DRAM** on the charts as a sign of this, even seeing Kospi as a leading indicator. He says the decline has only just started and that if it continues tomorrow he will buy something again.

On positions, on the day the **Nasdaq 100** bounced off its 50-day average he bought some spot, shorted **RGTI**, holds a 3x short on **DRAM** and added to **DELL**. He brought **SMTC** back into the portfolio at 161 and **PENG** again; he finds **AEHR**'s potential very high. He wrote that nobody listened to him about **SOFI**. He says that if AI growth were not so strong he would pull all his money out in this macro environment.

He recommends staying away from heavily indebted companies with high interest burdens, especially **CRWV**, and writes that if **NVDA** withdrew its support the company would go under in 2-3 months. He described cash at roughly 13.5%, with the hedge restraining about 7-7.5% in both directions.
